description: You will serve as a SUPERVISORY FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST in the COMPTROLLER DEPARTMENT of NAVAL SPECIAL WARFARE GROUP EIGHT.
qualifications:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-11 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Experience managing travel-related budgets and financial operations, including budget execution, expenditure analysis, financial controls, debt management, and reconciliation of travel obligations within official accounting systems. Demonstrated ability to oversee financial compliance, evaluate costs, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial transactions and records.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/0500/financial-administration-and-program-series-0501/

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
title: SUPERVISORY FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST
